Online application form deadline: 20 May 2026 (via application portal)
Online application form deadline: 30 June 2026 (via application portal)
All applicants from non-EU/EEA countries only need to upload their documents via the HdM application portal.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page gives '1,500 EUR' as 'Tuition fees per semester' for non-EU countries and the programme admission page shows 'Tuition Fees: 1,500.00' in the Non EU/EEA costs per semester, so the fee is 1,500 EUR per semester (not per year). Applicants with a German school leaving certificate (e.g. Abitur) are exempt — a Moroccan Baccalauréat holder is not. Documents: the admission page lists the pre-application/candidacy documents (school leaving certificate, recognition from Studienkolleg Konstanz if applicable, entrance exam certificate); the enrolment page lists the enrolment documents (passport photo, health insurance notification, proof of payment of fees, identity card scan). No page states a translation requirement for these documents. Intakes: the page gives entrance exam round deadlines for 2026 (Round 1 application form 20 May 2026; Round 2 30 June 2026); application portal opens 1 March 2026. No programme start date (day/month/year) is stated, only 'Beginning Winter semester'. Application channel: documents are uploaded via the HdM application portal (bewerbung.hdm-stuttgart.de) for non-EU/EEA applicants; EU/EEA applicants must additionally register on hochschulstart.de. No uni-assist/VPD route is mentioned. Language: the DAAD page says 'German language skills No minimum language level required', but non-native German speakers take a German language course; this does not make German a teaching language of the programme.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée obligatoire est exigé avant de pouvoir déposer votre candidature : formulaire de candidature en ligne, test d'anglais en ligne et entretien en ligne. Le réussir ne garantit pas une place (classement : examen 70 %, notes du diplôme 30 %).
note.en: A mandatory entrance exam is required before you can apply: online application form, online English test and online interview. Passing it does not guarantee a place (ranking: entrance exam 70%, school leaving certificate 30%).

evidence.quote: To be eligible to apply for a study place in the Social Media Marketing & Management programme, applicants must first successfully complete a mandatory entrance exam.
Admission is based on a ranking, with the entrance exam accounting for 70% and the school leaving certificate for 30%.

note.fr: Votre diplôme étranger doit être reconnu par le Studienkolleg Konstanz (certificat de reconnaissance). Demandez cette reconnaissance le plus tôt possible, les délais de traitement sont longs.
note.en: Your foreign certificate must be recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz (certificate of recognition). Apply for recognition as early as possible, processing times are long.

evidence.quote: To all applicants with an international degree: please apply for a recognition of your certificates from Studienkolleg Konstanz as soon as possible.
Please make sure to apply for the recognition as early as possible – ideally before you submit your application to HdM – as long processing times are to be expected.

note.fr: Candidats des pays non-UE/EEE sans diplôme d'accès allemand : vous devez vous présenter à la première session de l'examen d'entrée (Round 1).
note.en: Applicants from non-EU/EEA countries without a German higher education entrance qualification must apply for entrance exam Round 1.

evidence.quote: International applicants from non-EU/EEA countries without a German higher education entrance qualification must apply for entrance exam (Round 1).

note.fr: Après admission, vous aurez besoin d'un visa et d'une preuve de ressources financières (compte bloqué) pour étudier en Allemagne. Préparez ces démarches plusieurs mois à l'avance.
note.en: After admission you will need a visa and proof of sufficient funds (blocked account) to study in Germany. Prepare this several months in advance.

evidence.quote: As an international student, you will need a visa and proof of sufficient funds to study in Germany.
